userDirection: Create fresh project chats with the existing v5 app mention, preserving predecessors and native work.

implementation.appBootstrap: Optional chatgptAppMention in newly prepared handoffs selects a distinct persisted APP_JSON_ESCAPED_V1 format. The only qualified mention is @CatDesk-Local-Tunnel-v5. It appears on the first message line; identity and escaped handoff remain in the same frozen message.
implementation.compatibility: Omitted mention preserves historical serialization, message bytes and digests. Old readers reject unsupported new handoffs. The existing browser/composer transaction, ownership, draft, CAS and unknown-submission guards remain in force.
implementation.packageGate: App-prefixed creation refuses before browser launch if verified primitives lack the matching format marker; old-format operations remain supported.
implementation.authenticationReference: Public lifecycle probes and both daemon launch modes reuse the existing Windows User bearer reference only when no explicit process token exists. Explicit project-process credentials retain precedence; invalid credentials fail closed. Only a child start environment receives the inherited reference; parent and User environments are not rewritten.
implementation.scope: No new browser owner, queue, registry, authorization framework or tunnel. Mention text does not prove app activation, identify a caller or grant native execution.

rootRollover.note: Ignored fixture child is invoked by the bounded process-exit test.

wakeEnvelope.coverage: Old/new cross-language golden digests, invalid mentions, wire limit and unsupported old primitives.

retainedRegressionEvidence: New User-reference regression first reproduced USER_REFERENCE_NOT_USED_BY_OLD_LAUNCHER before the implementation correction.

A pre-existing load-error test expected generic completion uncertainty. The existing implementation correctly emits RESPONSE_LOAD_ERROR; the assertion now verifies that failure-specific behavior. No response retry or USER resend was added.
reviewAuthority: Retained exact Web review is INCONCLUSIVE; source acceptance, acknowledgment and producer/promotion authority are not established by these changes.
